column6: While I, the lady, was passing the day yesterday, while I, @wDN{Inana}, was passing the day yesterday, while I was passing the day, while I was dancing, while I was singing songs all day until evening, he met me, he met me. The lord, the friend of @wDN{An}, met me; the lord took me in his hands, @wDN{Ušumgal-ana} embraced me about my neck.

@q[Inana,Dumuzid]{“……, let me go, so that I can go to our house! Friend of @wDN{Enlil}, let me go, so that I can go to our house! What lie can I offer to my mother? What lie can I offer to my mother @wDN{Ningal}?”}

@q[Dumuzid,Inana]{“Let me teach you, let me teach you! @wDN{Inana}, let me teach you the lies of women: @q{“My girlfriend was dancing with me in the square. She ran around playfully with me, banging the drum. She sang her sweet songs for me. I passed the day there with her in pleasure and delight.”} Offer this as a lie to your own mother. As for us -- let me make love with you by moonlight! Let me loosen your hairgrip on the holy and luxuriant couch. May you pass a sweet day there with me in voluptuous pleasure.”}
@q[Inana,Dumuzid]{“I the maiden, in the streets and alleys, ……, by day I …… with you,”} @gap{1 line fragmentary} @gap{approx. 11 lines missing}

@gap{1 line fragmentary} @gap{1 line unclear} There he is, standing at our mother's gate, while I am rushing around in excitement. There he is standing at @wDN{Ningal's} gate, while I am rushing around in excitement. Oh that someone would tell my mother! May our neighbour come to sprinkle water on the floor! Oh that someone would tell my mother @wDN{Ningal}! May our neighbour come to sprinkle water on the floor: the fragrance of her dwelling is pleasant, and her words are delightful.

My lord is perfect for the holy embrace. @wDN{Ama-ušumgal-ana}, the son-in-law of @wDN{Suen}, Lord @wDN{Dumuzid}, is perfect for the holy embrace. @wDN{Ama-ušumgal-ana}, son-in-law of @wDN{Suen}, my lord: how pleasing is your lavishness, and how sweet-tasting are your green plants from the plain! @wDN{Ama-ušumgal-ana}, how pleasing is your lavishness, and how sweet-tasting are your green plants from the plain!
